# Ace Combat 7 -- in-game bindings

Generated by `azeron bindings`. Check each row against the game's controls screen.
If a key here does not match the game, fix `actions.yaml` -- not the profile.

| Action | Key in game | Sent from | Tags |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Change target | `Tab` | right:middle_3 | combat, required |
| Change weapon | `KeyC` | right:index_2 | combat |
| Fire gun | `ControlLeft` | left:index_3 | combat, required |
| Fire missile | `Space` | right:index_3 | combat, required |
| Flare | `KeyG` | left:middle_3 | combat |
| Accelerate | `KeyW` | left:stick.up | movement, required |
| Decelerate | `KeyS` | left:stick.down, left:index_1 | movement, required |
| Pitch down | `Digit1` | right:stick.up | movement, required |
| Pitch up | `Digit3` | right:stick.down | movement, required |
| Roll left | `KeyA` | right:stick.left | movement, required |
| Roll right | `KeyD` | right:stick.right | movement, required |
| Yaw left | `KeyQ` | left:stick.left | movement |
| Yaw right | `KeyE` | left:stick.right | movement |
| Pause | `Escape` | left:pinky_5 | menu |
| Change view | `KeyV` | right:dpad_press | utility |
| Look down | `Numpad2` | right:dpad_down | utility |
| Look left | `Numpad4` | right:dpad_left | utility |
